# docker_version (Data Source)

Reads the Docker Engine version, API version range and component versions of the provider's Docker host (`GET /version`), like the server half of `docker version`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_version" "engine" {}

output "engine" {
  value = {
    platform    = data.docker_version.engine.platform_name
    version     = data.docker_version.engine.version.version
    api_version = data.docker_version.engine.version.api_version
    min_api     = data.docker_version.engine.version.min_api_version
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of version_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `id` (String) ID of the daemon that answered (`ID` in `GET /info`).
- `platform_name` (String) Platform name of the daemon, e.g. `Docker Engine - Community`.
- `version` (Attributes) The GET /version response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--version))
- `version_json` (String) The Engine API GET /version response as JSON. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).

- `experimental` (Boolean) Upstream `Experimental`.
- `git_commit` (String) Upstream `GitCommit`.
- `go_version` (String) Upstream `GoVersion`.
- `kernel_version` (String) Upstream `KernelVersion`.
- `min_api_version` (String) Upstream `MinAPIVersion`.
- `os` (String) Upstream `Os`.

- `version` (String) Upstream `Version`.

### Nested Schema for `version.components`

Read-Only:

- `details` (String) Upstream `Details`. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, as upstream): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
- `name` (String) Upstream `Name`.
- `version` (String) Upstream `Version`.
